species.title: Choosing the right species
species.desc: Not all wood species are equal for heating. Choose hardwoods for slow combustion and high calorific value.

moisture.title: The importance of moisture content
moisture.desc: Dry wood (H1) releases more heat, clogs your flue less, and pollutes less. Discover the efficiency difference based on drying method.
moisture.h1_desc: Ready to use. Offers the best energy yield. Natural drying over 18 to 24 months or kiln-dried.
moisture.h2_desc: Needs to be stored in a dry, ventilated place for 6 to 12 months before use. More economical to purchase.
moisture.h3_desc: Freshly cut wood. Not usable as is. Requires at least 2 years of storage before it can be burned.
moisture.yield_desc: Burning wet wood wastes energy evaporating water before producing usable heat.

dimensions.title: Choosing the right length
dimensions.desc: Log length should match the size of your firebox. Measure the inside of your appliance and subtract 5cm for safety.
dimensions.small: Small wood stoves, cookers. Very fast drying.
dimensions.standard: Standard for most modern stoves and inserts.

storage.title: Golden rules of storage
storage.desc: Good wood can lose all its qualities if poorly stored. Protect your investment by following these simple rules.
storage.vent_1: Do not stack the woodpile directly against a wall (leave ~10cm).
storage.vent_2: Cross the logs at the ends to stabilize and ventilate the stack.
storage.vent_3: Choose a spot exposed to prevailing winds and sunlight.
storage.prot_1: Insulate from the ground using pallets or battens.
storage.prot_2: Cover only the top with sheet metal or a tarp (leave the sides open).
storage.prot_3: Avoid storing in a closed cellar (risk of mould).

return.title: Return Policy & Support
return.intro: At sotramsbois, we are committed to providing the highest quality biomass and firewood products. We understand, however, that exceptional circumstances may require a return. Here are our strict guidelines regarding returns, reverse logistics, and refunds for our professional and individual customers.
return.conditions_intro: Due to the bulky nature and logistical costs associated with our products (wood pallets, pellet big bags), returns are subject to strict conditions. You have a legal period of 14 clear days from the delivery date to exercise your right of withdrawal.
return.condition_1: Products must be in their original packaging, unopened, and undamaged (pallet wrap intact, pellet bags sealed).
return.condition_2: The wood must not have been exposed to bad weather or stored in inadequate conditions modifying its initial moisture content.
return.condition_3: The returned batch must correspond exactly to the batch numbers mentioned on the delivery note.
return.logistics_intro: Organizing the return of heavy goods requires the intervention of specialized carriers equipped with pallet jacks or onboard forklifts. Return costs are the exclusive responsibility of the customer, except in the event of a proven error on our part (product error, major non-conformity upon delivery).
return.transport_managed: We mandate our carrier network to collect the goods directly from the initial delivery location.
return.transport_client: The customer organizes the transport themselves to our central logistics platform. The chosen carrier must be authorized for heavy goods vehicles.
return.access_warning: The goods must be made accessible to 19-ton trucks equipped with a tail lift. If access is impossible on the day of collection, empty run fees of €108 incl. VAT (€90 excl. VAT) will be charged.
return.refund_intro: Refund processing takes place after qualitative and quantitative inspection of the returned goods at our logistics platform.
return.refund_step1: Upon receipt on the dock, our quality team inspects the product within 48 working hours. We check the integrity of the packaging and the moisture content (for firewood logs).
return.refund_step2: If the return criteria are met, the accounting department validates the amount to be refunded, deducting any reverse transport costs or discounts (if the packaging is damaged).
return.refund_step3: The refund is issued via the initial payment method within 5 to 7 working days after validation of the file.

guide_choix.le_guide_complet_pour_choisir_: The complete guide to choosing your firewood.
guide_choix.essence_humidit_longueur_optim: Species, moisture, length... Optimize your thermal yield and the lifespan of your installation with our professional recommendations.
guide_choix.le_choix_par_excellence_pour_u: The ultimate choice for industrial yield. These dense species offer a very high calorific value and slow combustion, guaranteeing continuous heat with fewer reloads. Ideal for bakeries, pizzerias, and professional boiler rooms.
guide_choix.bon_pouvoir_calorifique_mais_c: Good calorific value but faster combustion. Easy to split and ignite. Note: chestnut tends to crackle and throw sparks, it strictly requires a closed fireplace. Very useful for quickly boosting temperature.
guide_choix.montent_trs_vite_en_temprature: Very fast temperature rise. Ideal for lighting a fire or for ovens requiring a rapid heat-up. However, their resin tends to quickly clog the flues. Use sparingly or well mixed.
